name: hookrelay
description: Self-hostable webhook gateway: durable ingest, signed delivery, retries, dead-letter queue and replay.
author: Hajdu Benedek

scripts.dev: concurrently -k -n api,worker,web,mock -c blue,magenta,green,yellow "pnpm --filter @hookrelay/api dev:api" "pnpm --filter @hookrelay/api dev:worker" "pnpm --filter @hookrelay/dashboard dev" "pnpm --filter @hookrelay/mock-receiver dev"
